## Engagement Scout (09)
08:40, 13:40, 19:40 Dublin. 2 Google searches (Serper, past week) for public LinkedIn posts on BA / data / product / automation topics.
Skips: posts already queued, job ads, your own posts, same author within 7 days. Max 3 new per run, max 8 waiting.
Each post > comment drafted by the Voice Drafter > EngagementQueue (**Pending**) > one Slack digest.
**You** open the post, read it fully, tweak, paste, set **Commented**. Nothing is posted automatically.
